entities.summary: Heinrich Georg Franz Stockmann was a German-Finnish businessman, commercial counsellor and founder of the Stockmann department store in Helsinki. He was a pioneer in Finnish retail trade and built one of Helsinki's largest commercial enterprises during the latter half of the 19th century.
